assets.label: Relaunch ad — "The crunch says it all." (19 s, voiceover + music)
assets.prompt_used: Edit: prompts/lays-rebrand/edit.json. A pinch of salt.'), friends sharing chips on a rooftop at golden hour ('That crunch.') — then the glossy gold Classic pack concept with 'The crunch says it all.' and 'Classic in gold · Baked in matte'. Voiceover: 'Only ten potato varieties make the cut. Sliced thin. Cooked golden. A pinch of salt. And then... that crunch. Lay's. The crunch says it all.' Music: bright, upbeat instrumental.
